chapterTitle: Chapter 3: Synaptic Memoriam of a steel fossil shell
editorText:
John felt himself viewing life through the eyes of a machine. The feed dated the last date of the lost facillities occupancy. Things seemed pretty routine. Rows upon rows of machines lined up. In an almost military fassion. Rows of protectant infantrymen but what was in fact the new worker-bot project.

One of the machines seemed different. This one seemed to represent the rest of them collectively. He stepped out of the line and presented himself to the commander. “Serva Vitae 1, progress report”, Marcellus was swift in his command, with unwavering expectation that could not be disobeyed. After all he was just a machine.

“Aaah yes Commander, well all is on schedule. My father Dr has advised me of new progress on the regenerative growth factorial of the tendon tissue.” The robot seemed pleased. A mere attempt to shade the fact that one of his brothers had sustained a tendon fracture.

“And what might this be for” Marcellus was intrigued. “Do we need to be assigning our efforts to healing machines? Or humans? I would certainly hope that Dr Wolfgang accounted for this as a directive of CLEAR and has run sandpits on the data?”. Serva Vitae 1 responded almost as calmly as a first meeting and handshake was occurring. “In fact yes, In clear alignment with the CLEAR protocol”

One of robots in the rear of the lines seemed to have a faint limp in his system at the fluidic hydraulic tendons that stitched into the calf section of the machine.

“Vitae 1 has one of your brothers sustained an injury”. At this moment John could only just make out the shoulder of the figure that had entered the facility at the rear to tend to the machine.

“Aah he arrives himself the man of the hour! Wolfgang, glad you could join us!”

“Commander yes we have allotted the research to preserve and increase the survivabillity of the Serva Vitae worker Prototype colony, This is in clear directive of trialled and tested CLEAR protocols established by the AI”

“You see that machine over there Vitae 1, I am declaring that machine faulty and undeployable, It is unfortunate that I am placing it under decommission status”.,. He paused. “What I want you to do is discard of this machine. I can’t think of a better time to test your in built weapon systems. SV1 Vaporise that machine”. Said Marcellus.

Upon the request Marcellus’s escort drew their pistols from their holsters aiming them at SV1’s skull. The different machine remained calm though it seemed.

VS1 what are you doing carry out your command as ordered or report for decommissioning.

“Commander” with a peaceful humming sound the voice seemed to calm the room around it with a humble resonance.

“I do not believe that it would be efficient for me to dispose of XA24795 in the manner you have advised. This would render it’s on board memory circuits completely irreparable and unretrievable and”, “SV1!! I have given you a clear concise command, now.. will you capitulate”, “I am sorry I do appologise commander but some logic within me feels that this would be a waste of your calculated resources. Can I advise that”, “No SV1!”.

The commander stepped away from the robot as 3 troops stepped in prodding their rifles on SV1’s chest. He stepped back walking over to the groups of scientists and engineers that were observing the assembly. One of the older Engineers stepped forward.

“It seems that this particular machine has well formed a consciousness commander, Maybe this is not the time to make rash decisions, we should assess, reassess, take our time, it might prove more effective than we had previously anticipated. This is very different from my earlier recordings, might  I suggest that we take sv1 for further testing and neural analysis. This kind of logical execution has engaged on new levels we have not seen before, It seems to have formed it’s own logic routines based on no logic for us our our programming. It would appear commander that the algorithm has evolved beyond our workings. Become sentient.

This is.. This is really the dawn of a new age commander we possibly could have stumbled across, Well let me just state it would not be wise to extinguish brash decisions in the this instance.. Could be considered by some in the scientific community unruly”

“Enough!!” Marcellus broke out into a rage red in the face. Then, he collected himself as though nothing had ever happened. “The machine is faulty it will not follow orders. Instruct your Engineers and scientists to decommission the program. We can’t use machines that don’t follow orders Dr.. Dismissed”

“Very well Commander, as you wish” Siad Wolfgang while he looked over at XA24795 with an expression, as if to tell him that every thing would be ok.

Row after row the machines left the chamber one after the other and amongst those leaving a faint hop echoed down the line in spacial compensation. The echoes of what soon would be XA24795.

One of Marcellus’s security escort walked over placing eletronic magnetic cuffs. XA24795 was placed in cuffs that bound to the machines long instramentous arms. XA24795 held it’s composure and
